<thought>The dimensions of the simulation box are 4.038930 Å in each direction (x, y, and z). Since the simulation replicates the unit cell 5 times in each direction, the total dimensions are 20.19465 Å in x and y directions. The surface area for the [0, 0, 1] direction is the area of the xy plane, which is \(20.19465 \times 20.19465\) Å².

The surface energy \( \gamma \) can be calculated using the formula:
\[ \gamma = \frac{E_{\text{slab}} - E_{\text{bulk}}}{2A} \]
